meta.ogTitle: One advisor. Every ocean. — Cruises with Dean on Deck
meta.ogDescription: Compare the cruise lines Dean books and find your next voyage with personal support at no extra service fee.

hero.heading: One advisor. *Every ocean.*
hero.lede: From adults-only escapes to family adventures, luxury voyages and LGBTQ+ charters, let’s find your fit. Use my Virgin Voyages link to book independently, or contact me first about booking with my support on another line.

cta.heading: Not sure where to start? *Let’s talk.*
cta.lede: Tell me who’s sailing and what you’d love to experience. We’ll explore your options together, with no extra service fee for my help.

rockstar.heading: Cruise like a RockStar
rockstar.intro: Three ways to sail: Mega RockStar, RockStar and Non-RockStar. Find the experience that fits your voyage.
rockstar.regular: Choose an Inside, Sea View or Sea Terrace cabin for the Virgin experience. RockStar suite privileges are not included.
coreItems: RockStar Agent team for reservations and requests
Early boarding and priority booking access
Curated in-suite bar — first round included
Shipwide alcoholic drinks are extra — no unlimited drinks package
megaItems: Bottomless in-suite bar plus a daily shipwide Bar Tab (Virgin’s drink and bottle limits apply)
Private transfers or parking where available; Work from Sea Wi-Fi
rockstar.note: Benefits vary by suite and availability. Dean can confirm the details for your sailing.
